connector.name: Tempmd
connector.registryDescription: Publish artifacts to one stable public temp.md link that updates in place. No account needed.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.temp.md over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package tempmd-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the huangdun account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer followed by a temp.md account API key for account-owned publishing and account tools

env.name: TEMPMD_API_URL
env.description: Override the temp.md API base URL (default: https://api.temp.md)
